The legend

Not your average hooded archer

Every trader wears the hood. Not everyone shows the face underneath.

Legend says a green-cloaked archer lives in the market's forest, robbing whales and market makers of their pumps and handing it back to the retail dwelling below. But unlike the old stories — this one never hides what he's feeling.

Euphoric on a green day. Wrecked on a red one. Dead asleep watching a 3am candle. That's not weakness — that's every trader alive.

Read the full legend

The community started calling him ROBIN THE FACE — not for the hood, but for the face underneath it. Twenty-five expressions, one for every mood a chart has ever pulled out of you. We're not selling "always up." We're selling the truth, and the truth has a lot of faces.
